summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return (US equivalent: Form 8-K/10b5-1 buyback update) dated September 18, 2026. The issuer disclosed ten consecutive on-market repurchases of Class A ordinary shares (HKEX code 09888) for cancellation, from September 7 to 18, 2026, totaling roughly 5.57 million shares (about 0.25% of existing issued shares), at prices ranging from HKD 86.909 to HKD 92.383 per share. Shares bought are not yet cancelled, leaving a repurchase overhang; no board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated.
